summary: Match the beginning of a string.
documentation: startswith checks whether a string begins with a prefix. A tuple of prefixes can be used to test alternatives. Optional indices limit the tested region.
inputs: A prefix string or tuple of prefixes, plus optional indices.
caution: Matching is case-sensitive. This exercise deliberately keeps that behavior.
scenarios: Route imported records with known reference prefixes.
Recognize a command at the start of a message.
Classify file names before further processing.
title: Recognize invoice references
problem: Return true if the input string starts with exactly "INV-". Do not trim or change the case first.
goal: Use str.startswith() or an equivalent approach that demonstrates the same concept.
